description: Co-occurrence of 3-oxoacid CoA-transferase with the leucine catabolism module and thiolase complement across 15 fungal reference proteomes
code:
import requests, pandas as pd, numpy as np, os
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact, mannwhitneyu

# One query per gene family, OR-ed over 15 fungal reference-proteome strains.
TAX={"330879":"A. fumigatus","227321":"A. nidulans","425011":"A. niger","510516":"A. oryzae",
     "500485":"P. rubens","367110":"N. crassa","229533":"F. graminearum","242507":"M. oryzae",
     "431241":"T. reesei","284591":"Y. lipolytica","237561":"C. albicans","559292":"S. cerevisiae",
     "284812":"S. pombe","214684":"C. neoformans","237631":"U. maydis"}
orgq="(" + " OR ".join(f"organism_id:{t}" for t in TAX) + ")"
FAM={"SCOT_2.8.3.5":"ec:2.8.3.5","HMGCL_4.1.3.4":"ec:4.1.3.4","MCC_6.4.1.4":"ec:6.4.1.4",
     "IVD_1.3.8.4":"ec:1.3.8.4","ACAT_2.3.1.9":"ec:2.3.1.9","thiolase_PF00108":"xref:pfam-PF00108"}
G=pd.DataFrame(index=[TAX[t] for t in TAX])
for name,qq in FAM.items():
    r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
        params={"query":f"({qq}) AND {orgq}","size":500,
                "fields":"accession,organism_id","format":"tsv"},timeout=55)
    lines=[l.split("\t") for l in r.text.split("\n") if l.strip()][1:]
    c=pd.Series([TAX[x[1]] for x in lines if x[1] in TAX]).value_counts()
    G[name]=[int(c.get(o,0)) for o in G.index]
pd.set_option("display.width",250)
print("=== Gene counts, 15 fungal reference proteomes (UniProt EC / Pfam) ===")
print(G.to_string())

G["SCOT"]=G["SCOT_2.8.3.5"]>0
G["LEUmod"]=(G["HMGCL_4.1.3.4"]>0)&(G["MCC_6.4.1.4"]>0)
ct=pd.crosstab(G["SCOT"],G["LEUmod"])
print("\nSCOT present (rows) x leucine-catabolism module present (cols):\n",ct)
tab=[[int(ct.loc[True,True]) if (True in ct.index and True in ct.columns) else 0,
      int(ct.loc[True,False]) if (True in ct.index and False in ct.columns) else 0],
     [int(ct.loc[False,True]) if (False in ct.index and True in ct.columns) else 0,
      int(ct.loc[False,False]) if (False in ct.index and False in ct.columns) else 0]]
orr,pv=fisher_exact(tab)
print(f"Fisher exact OR={orr}, two-sided p={pv:.5f}, n={len(G)}; concordance {(G['SCOT']==G['LEUmod']).sum()}/{len(G)}")

a=G.loc[G.SCOT,"thiolase_PF00108"]; b=G.loc[~G.SCOT,"thiolase_PF00108"]
u,p2=mannwhitneyu(a,b,alternative="greater")
print(f"PF00108 complement: SCOT+ median {a.median():.0f} (n={len(a)}) vs SCOT- median {b.median():.0f} (n={len(b)}), U={u}, one-sided p={p2:.4f}")

Gp=G.sort_values(["SCOT","LEUmod","thiolase_PF00108"],ascending=False)[list(FAM)]
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8.5,6))
im=ax.imshow(Gp.values,cmap="YlGnBu",aspect="auto",vmin=0,vmax=max(6,Gp.values.max()))
ax.set_xticks(range(Gp.shape[1])); ax.set_xticklabels(["SCOT\n2.8.3.5","HMG-CoA\nlyase","MCC\n6.4.1.4","IVD\n1.3.8.4","ACAT\n2.3.1.9","thiolases\nPF00108"],fontsize=9)
ax.set_yticks(range(Gp.shape[0])); ax.set_yticklabels(Gp.index,fontsize=9)
for i in range(Gp.shape[0]):
    for j in range(Gp.shape[1]):
        v=Gp.values[i,j]; ax.text(j,i,int(v),ha="center",va="center",fontsize=9,color="white" if v>4 else "black")
ax.set_title("Acetoacetate and leucine catabolism gene counts in 15 fungi\nUniProt reference proteomes, sorted by CoA-transferase presence",fontsize=10)
plt.colorbar(im,ax=ax,label="genes per proteome"); plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

out="/agent/jobs/9bb0dca9-746d-4644-82c5-c5a22d4031ad/provenance"; os.makedirs(out,exist_ok=True)
G.to_csv(f"{out}/table_fungal_comparative_inventory.csv")
print("saved:",f"{out}/table_fungal_comparative_inventory.csv")
